bear_assumptions: USD 13 normalized ADR earnings at 19x; AI demand slows, overseas-fab dilution and capital intensity pressure margins, and geopolitical and customer-concentration risk compress the multiple.
base_assumptions: USD 16.50 normalized ADR earnings at 23x; leading-node and advanced-packaging demand remains strong, 2026 growth guidance is substantially delivered, and margins normalize below the exceptional second quarter.
bull_assumptions: USD 19 normalized ADR earnings at 26x; 2nm ramps cleanly, AI accelerator and advanced-packaging demand persists, pricing and utilization defend margins, and execution outweighs overseas-fab costs.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if price offers a sufficient margin of safety and scenario returns clear every economic and relationship gate while 2nm, advanced packaging, margins and cash conversion remain durable; downgrade if AI demand, leading-node share, pricing, margins, customer concentration, overseas-fab economics, export controls or Taiwan geopolitical conditions deteriorate.
